newsitem.title: LEBANON: BLC unchanged, Solidere fall in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: BLC unchanged, Solidere fall in Beirut.

text.p: Shares of Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce were steady and Solidere shares fell on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday.

BLC closed at $12.375 on trade of 3,000 shares compared to 5,000 shares that changed hands a day earlier at the same price. Also traded were 6,697 BLC shares in a block trade inside the bourse hall at $12.375 on Thursday.
Solidere A shares fell 2.3 percent to $10.75 from $11 on Wednesday and B shares fell 1.2 percent to $10.75 from $10.875.
Turnover in Solidere rose to 29,032 shares from 16,686 a day earlier and value was $310,614.75 from $182,296.25.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.43 percent to 81.00 and the BLOM stock index fell 1.35 percent to 907.44.
